item.title: HAVE YOUR SAY: Council launches consultation as part of parking scheme review in Rickmansworth
item.description: A controversial Controlled Parking Zone (CPZ) in the Moneyhill area of Rickmansworth is set to be reviewed. Three Rivers District Council (TRDC) introduced the CPZ in December 2024 in response to local parking problems. However, shopkeepers shared concerns about the costs, including a £536 annual permit. item.description: Police are appealing for witnesses, information and dash cam footage following a serious road traffic collision in Croxley Green. item.title: ‘WELL-DESERVED RESULT’: Youth basketball team in Northwood makes a determined comeback
item.description: Merchant Taylors’ School’s Under 18 Basketball Team secured their first win of the season last month. The team faced Dwight School London at home on Wednesday, November 12, and were determined to secure the win after losing their first two games. item.title: ‘SO PROUD’: Thriving athletics Watford club celebrates 100 years of success
item.description: Watford Harriers Athletics Club celebrated the impressive milestone of 100 years of coaching and competition in 2025. The club first brought athletics to the town in 1925, when the track was opened by the late Prince Phillip. item.title: ‘GREATEST STRENGTH’: Religious communities join together for Bushey Interfaith Forum
item.description: Support for vulnerable local people was the theme of this year’s gathering of the Bushey Interfaith Forum. Councillors, residents and religious representatives met to discuss how faiths can help those in poverty or isolation. item.description: The entrance to Paines Lane Cemetery has been given a much-needed upgrade, after a request from the Pinner Association to return the entranceway to its former glory.
